PhotographyFaq1.subtitle: FAQ
PhotographyFaq1.description: Find answers to the most common questions about our photography services, booking process, pricing and more. If you still need help, feel free to contact our team anytime.

faqGroups.question: How long have you been a photographer?
faqGroups.answer: We have been working in the photography industry for over 10 years, capturing weddings, newborn, fashion and portfolio photography. Our experience allows us to create beautiful, high-quality images that tell your unique story.

faqGroups.question: Do you edit all of your photographs?
faqGroups.answer: Yes. Every image we deliver is carefully selected and professionally edited for colour, light and tone so your gallery feels consistent and timeless.

faqGroups.question: Do you work with a second photographer?
faqGroups.answer: For weddings and large events we usually work with a second photographer, so no important moment or angle is missed.

faqGroups.question: Do you have an assistant?
faqGroups.answer: Yes, an assistant joins us on most shoots to help with lighting, equipment and keeping everything running smoothly.

faqGroups.question: Do you also provide video services?
faqGroups.answer: We do. Our team offers wedding cinematography, event films and drone coverage alongside photography.

faqGroups.question: Do you have past clients we can speak to as references?
faqGroups.answer: Of course. We are happy to connect you with past clients who can share their experience of working with us.

faqGroups.question: Are our digital files watermarked?
faqGroups.answer: No. The final digital files you receive are high resolution and free from any watermark.

faqGroups.question: How many pictures will we receive?
faqGroups.answer: It depends on the package and length of the shoot. A full-day wedding typically includes several hundred edited images.

faqGroups.question: How long does it take before we receive our products and photographs?
faqGroups.answer: Sneak peeks are shared within a week. The complete edited gallery is usually delivered within 3 to 4 weeks.

philosophy.title: Light first
philosophy.text: I plan every image around light — the hour, the weather, the window. Light tells the story; I just frame it.

philosophy.title: Honesty over perfection
philosophy.text: I'd rather keep the wind in your hair than a flawless pose. Real moments age better than perfect ones.

philosophy.title: Slow seeing
philosophy.text: Fewer frames, more attention. Waiting is part of the craft — for a glance, a break in the clouds, a quiet second.
